title: Synthetic Retry Safety Guide
text: Use an idempotency key so retries can be recognized as the same operation. Record the request outcome before sending the response. Set a bounded retry policy with exponential backoff and jitter.

title: Synthetic Service Health Guide
text: Track request latency and error rate for each service. Compare current signals with a documented service objective. Use a health check that verifies dependencies needed to serve real requests.

title: Synthetic Deployment Guide
text: Release a change to a small test group before expanding availability. Define rollback conditions before starting the release. Compare error rate and latency with the previous stable version.

title: Synthetic Data Handling Guide
text: Keep credentials in a secret store and never include them in application logs. Collect only the data needed for the feature. Apply access checks before returning a document to a caller.
